ADDED i2: Test suite for {@link DayOfMonth}.

The tests run under EvoSuite's mocked system clock, which is fixed so that {@code DayOfMonth.now()} consistently resolves
ADDED i3: The day-of-month produced by the fixed mock clock used in this suite.
ADDED i6: A ZoneOffset carries no day-of-month field, so extraction is impossible.
ADDED i8: equals is symmetric: the reverse comparison is also false.
ADDED i9: A ChronoField is not a DayOfMonth, so equals must be false.
ADDED i12: Adjusting to the day it already has leaves the temporal unchanged.
ADDED i15: The mocked month does not have 31 days, so day 31 is invalid for it.
ADDED i16: Day 14 fits in any month.
ADDED i20: A ThaiBuddhistDate can be converted to a LocalDate, so extraction works.
ADDED i21: from() on a DayOfMonth simply returns the same value.
ADDED i22: atMonth is non-mutating; the original day is preserved.
ADDED i23: atYearMonth is non-mutating; the original day is preserved.
